'''Ivan Markus''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 1999 Lund tournament]] on 31 August 1999 with Cloud City pot purri, according to Erik Hansson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d35">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-lund-sweden-990831d35/ lund-sweden-990831], DeckTech (Erik "erikaros" Hansson, 10 September 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-09-10-lund-sweden-990831d35/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
